explication: This repository is an ASP.NET Core Clean Architecture starter/template, with both a contributor-management sample and a minimal cart-and-catalog sample. The principal workflows accept HTTP requests, handle application use cases, apply domain behavior, and access persistence or integrations. The graph preserves both samples’ distinct capabilities and the shared architectural layers. Source excerpts confirm selected dependency registrations, listing-query persistence, and contributor deletion/event dispatch; other endpoint-to-handler wiring is not shown, so those links are omitted.
